description: This file defines a controller class for managing the 'credit' total extension in the OpenCart administration panel. It includes methods to display the configuration page and save settings related to the credit total, utilizing OpenCart's framework components such as the language loader, URL generator, view renderer, and permission checks.

classes.name: Credit
classes.description: Controller class for the 'credit' total extension in the OpenCart admin system.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the configuration page for the 'credit' total extension, setting up breadcrumb navigation, loading language strings, view components, and rendering the template.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the saving of configuration settings for the 'credit' total extension, performing permission checks, saving data, and returning JSON response.
